options.name: comment
options.description: The description of the federated realm. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the federated realm. May contain 1 to 256 characters; can include UTF-8.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the federated realm in JSON format.
